files.role: FastAPI application factory and ASGI entrypoint

public_objects.name: app
public_objects.purpose: FastAPI application instance with calendar router mounted

files.role: psycopg2 connection pool management — acquire/release lifecycle via psycopg2.pool.ThreadedConnectionPool

public_objects.name: get_connection
public_objects.purpose: Acquire a psycopg2 connection from the pool; caller must return it via put_connection

public_objects.name: put_connection
public_objects.purpose: Return a psycopg2 connection to the pool after use

public_objects.name: init_pool
public_objects.purpose: Initialize the ThreadedConnectionPool from ATLAS_PG_* env vars; called at startup

files.role: Pydantic request/response models for CalendarEvent CRUD

public_objects.name: CalendarEventCreate
public_objects.purpose: Request body for POST /api/cal/events — all required fields plus optional nullable fields

public_objects.name: CalendarEventPatch
public_objects.purpose: Request body for PATCH /api/cal/events/{id} — all fields Optional; uses sentinel UNSET to distinguish omit from explicit None

public_objects.name: CalendarEventRow
public_objects.purpose: Internal row shape for a CalendarEvent as returned from the DB

private_objects.name: UNSET
private_objects.purpose: Sentinel value for CalendarEventPatch — distinguishes omitted fields from explicit None

files.role: CalendarEventRepository — all SQL for calendar_events table via psycopg2 with RealDictCursor

methods.name: list_events
methods.purpose: List events ordered by start_at ASC; optionally filtered by start (inclusive) and end (exclusive)

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.purpose: Fetch a single event by UUID; returns None if not found

methods.name: create_event
methods.purpose: Insert a new calendar_event row and return the created record

methods.name: patch_event
methods.purpose: Partially update an event; only provided (non-UNSET) fields are included in the SET clause; returns None if event not found

methods.name: delete_event
methods.purpose: Delete an event by ID; returns True if deleted, False if not found

files.role: CalendarEventMapper — converts CalendarEventRow records to Dataset response

methods.name: to_dataset
methods.purpose: Map a list of CalendarEventRow records to a Dataset with full schema declaration and row_actions=['edit','delete']

methods.name: to_row
methods.purpose: Convert a single CalendarEventRow to a Dataset row dict with all declared schema keys

files.role: FastAPI router implementing the four /api/cal/events endpoints

public_objects.name: router
public_objects.purpose: APIRouter instance with prefix /api/cal, tag calendar

files.role: Runtime schema loaded idempotently at startup — copied from 10_schema.sql at sprint-close. Contains CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for calendar_events.
Local development entrypoint — starts uvicorn on CALENDAR_APP_PORT (default 8023)
